class.name: inspire_franka_sim/ThreadPairPlugin
class.description: Publishes the threaded M24 nut's axial position and twist angle on /thread_state, clamps the thread while /thread_hold is true, and returns it to its start pose on the bolt on /reset_thread. Needed by inspire_franka_policy_scene.xml, whose nut is not part of the robot and so has no ros2_control state interface; idle in every other scene.

class.name: inspire_franka_sim/IsaacHandPlugin
class.description: The parts of Isaac Lab's Inspire hand an MJCF cannot express: follower targets set from leader targets (Isaac's target-level mimic), the 1 rad/s joint velocity limit, and PhysX's load-dependent joint friction. Configured by the isaac_hand/* custom fields of inspire_franka_policy_scene.xml; idle in every other scene.

class.name: inspire_franka_sim/FingertipForcePlugin
class.description: Publishes the thumb and index pad forces on /fingertip_force the way ForgeUltra's force-observing student sees them: net pad contact force along the calibrated tip frame's -X, in N. Idle in a scene without the thumb_tip/index_tip bodies.
